_comment: Real programs from the Sept 2026 research, re-checked against live pages on 2026-09-12. Re-verify every figure on the platform before acting; scopes and pools change weekly. max_payout_usd is the program/pool maximum, not the expected payout. days_since_scope_change and competition are operator estimates refreshed from the live scope page. HARD RULE: any target with a submission fee, stake or deposit is excluded — the human puts no money in. rank.py enforces this.

_schema.name: program or contest name
_schema.capital_required_usd: any upfront stake or deposit; > 0 excludes the target
_schema.submission_fee: true if the program charges a per-report fee; excludes the target
_schema.fee_checked: ISO date the live page was checked for fees, or null if unchecked (treated as fee-charging)
_schema.days_since_scope_change: days since the in-scope code last changed (lower = fresher = fewer eyes)
_schema.deadline: ISO date if time-boxed, else null

targets.name: ENS standing bug bounty (mainnet contracts)
targets.kyc: generally not required; may be requested where law requires
targets.notes: ACTIVE TARGET. Scope = latest finalized mainnet release per ensdomains/ens-contracts wiki deployments page, plus ens-app-v3, ens-metadata-service, ensdomains-landing. Critical up to $250k (min $10k), High $25k-$100k, Medium $10k, Low $2.5k. PoC always required. Known issues: three NameWrapper/DAO items from 2023. The separate ENS audit COMPETITION (Manager/Explorer web apps, ends 2026-09-14) charges a submission fee and is EXCLUDED; stay in the standing bounty's contract scope. Repo last commit 2026-09-11.

targets.name: Granite Protocol bug bounty
targets.notes: ACTIVE TARGET (third). Bitcoin lending on Stacks, CLARITY language (small researcher pool = edge). Live since 2025-02-26, updated 2026-07-25, 31 assets pinned by on-chain address. Critical $25k-$100k, High $5k-$25k, Medium $2.5k, Low $1k. PoC required. Known issues: soft-liquidation risk, governance input validation, deployment param validation, references to non-existent methods. Sources fetched from Hiro API into work/granite/. 2026-09-13: BOTH markets migrated in Aug 2026 to new contract sets (USDCx ~$5M -> SPSX722NK9V3A8D3CVQT0CDY4EBQ3E9FSDDE61FT.*, aeUSDC ~$97k -> SP119QJ4NVE3RQP8RXJVW5EXAV3XD4CJZWRCEEAAR.*); the scope page (updated 25 Jul 2026) still lists the de-allowlisted predecessors. Auditing the live sets; any report must flag the stale scope. See findings/audit-notes-granite.md.

targets.name: 1inch smart contracts bug bounty
targets.notes: ACTIVE TARGET (second). Program live since 2026-06-11, updated 2026-08-14. Scope = 8 GitHub repos at their LATEST TAG/RELEASE only: limit-order-protocol, fusion-protocol (Limit Order Settlement), token-plugins, farming, delegating, cross-chain-swap, solana-crosschain-protocol, solana-fusion. Critical $30k-$500k (10% of funds affected; must be live on mainnet), High $10k-$30k, Medium $2k-$10k, Low $100-$2k. PoC always required. Must report within 24h of discovery. Out of scope: imported contracts, fee-on-transfer incompatibility, economic/oracle/liquidity attacks, centralisation, theoretical. FLAG: program text lists 'AI-generated reports' under prohibited activities. Any report here must be authored and submitted by the human in their own words from the verified finding and PoC; machine drafts are internal only.

targets.name: StackingDAO bug bounty (stSTX / stBTC liquid stacking)
targets.notes: ACTIVE TARGET (fourth). Liquid stacking on Stacks, CLARITY. 37 assets under SP4SZE494VC2YC5JYG7AYFQ44F5Q4PYV7DVMDPBG.*, PRIMACY OF IMPACT for Critical/High (any StackingDAO contract with an in-scope impact counts, so the stale-scope problem seen on Granite does not apply). Critical = 10% of funds affected, min $20k, max $100k; High $1k-$20k. PoC required, no KYC, no fee text on the info page. Fresh surface: stBTC product added 13 Aug 2026 (sBTC-bonded PoX-5 signer product, ~152 BTC supply), Clarity Alliance PoX-5 audit 12 Aug 2026 (unfixed items there are ineligible). Deployer is hyperactive (14k deployments, daily DAO proposals). stx-reserve-v2 holds ~9.1M STX. Public GitHub repo lags (last commit Apr 2026); on-chain source via Hiro is authoritative. Sources in work/stackingdao/.
